subject: MSA + Order Form: onboarding kickoff and governance/exhibit clarifications
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@helium.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Rhodes <ben.rhodes@vertexsystems.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Contract kickoff — Order Form + SOW attached

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're ready to start the contracting path for the pilot (Order Form + MSA). I'm attaching our current order form and a short SOW so you can see the customer-side expectations.

A few items we'd like the legal/ops team to confirm up front:
- Data residency: we prefer EU but can accept US for the pilot if controls are documented.
- Indemnity / liability cap: our procurement team normally asks for a 1x fee cap; will Redwood consider a mutual cap tied to fees?
- Audit logs / access to traceability records for compliance — need confirmation on retention window.

Target timeline: we'd like a signed agreement by Sept 10 if possible. Can you confirm who on your side will drive redlines and whether you prefer to use Redwood's MSA or our template? Also, please confirm any documents you need from our side (tax forms, SOC2).

Attachments: Helium_OrderForm_v3.docx, Helium_SOW.pdf

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Head of Partnerships, HeliumAI
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@helium.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract kickoff — Order Form + SOW attached

Hi Sophie — great to hear and glad the demo landed.

High-level plan from our side:
1) We generally prefer to start from Redwood's MSA for speed; we can review your order form as the canonical commercial doc.
2) Kimberly (legal) will lead redlines; Marcus will handle billing/finance items.
3) To speed intake, please send: legal entity full name, incorporation jurisdiction, billing contact (name/email), and whether the EU residency requirement is mandatory for pilot or optional.

Initial asks for your team (attached):
- Please fill the Party_Details_Template.xlsx with signer, address, and PO info.
- If Exhibit A (usage/billable items) varies from your order form, add line items to Initial_ExhibitA_Spreadsheet.csv so we can map pricing and quotas.

Proposed cadence: 48-hour initial review from legal (high-level redlines), then a canary/finance sync to resolve billing terms. If we agree to Redwood MSA, that typically shortens procurement review.

I've attached the intake templates referenced above. Once we have the party sheet filled, Kimberly will circulate our redline-first-pass. If there are specific audit artifacts you need (SOC2), let us know and we'll share current reports under NDA.

Attachments: Party_Details_Template.xlsx, Initial_ExhibitA_Spreadsheet.csv

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@helium.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract kickoff — Order Form + SOW attached

Hi Sophie — copying next steps and what to expect from the legal review.

Quick answers to the items you raised:
- Data residency: Redwood supports region-specific hosting. For pilot we can provide US-only or EU-only deployment depending on contract language — please confirm which is non-negotiable. If EU residency is required, we'll add a data residency exhibit and estimate timing for any additional compliance attestations.
- Liability cap: our standard position is a mutual cap linked to fees. We can accept a 1x fee cap with limited carveouts for IP infringement and gross negligence; we'll propose language in our redline.
- Audit logs / retention: we can commit to X months of retention (we will specify exact period in the exhibit) and provide access methods for traceability records.

To streamline, we recommend Redwood's MSA with your order form as the commercial attachment. If you insist on starting from your template we'll scope the changes and provide a redline summary of major deviations.

Please see the attached guideline and a tracked Exhibit A template for budget/usage mapping. Questions for your procurement ops: 1) who will sign (name/title/email), 2) any required PO flow or billing references, 3) preferred signer jurisdiction.

Timeline we propose:
- 48 hours for initial redline (we'll flag any must-have legal items)
- 3 business days for a negotiated redline set after your comments
- Goal: execute by Sept 10 if party details arrive by end of week.

Attachments: Redline_Guidelines.pdf, Tracked_ExhibitA_template.docx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@helium.ai>

Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@helium.ai>, Ben Rhodes <ben.rhodes@vertexsystems.com>

Thanks Mina and Kimberly — appreciate the clear path. Forwarding procurement contact and party information so you can proceed:
- Signing party: HeliumAI, Inc.
- Signer: Ethan Cole, VP Finance <ethan.cole@helium.ai>
- Billing contact: accounts-payable@helium.ai
- Jurisdiction: Delaware, US

I've attached our completed party sheet for your intake. Our procurement lead Ethan will take the contract redline conversation and can execute via DocuSign. Link to placeholder envelope: https://docusign.net/xyz/transaction/abc123

We are comfortable using Redwood's MSA if it expedites timing. Please push the initial redline to us by tomorrow EOD per the timeline above.
